title: The baby monitor started singing at 3 a.m.
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, dark, moody, low key lighting, 35mm film grain, desaturated, realistic, suburban American house at night, no text, no watermark
hook_text: The baby monitor started singing at 3 a.m.

scenes.narration: At 3:07 a.m., the baby monitor on my nightstand started humming a lullaby.

shots.prompt: baby monitor receiver glowing green on a nightstand in a pitch black bedroom, sound level lights lit, close up

scenes.narration: Problem is, my daughter was asleep in our bed. Right between us.

shots.prompt: dark bedroom seen from the foot of the bed, two adult shapes under a duvet with a small child-sized lump between them, moonlight through blinds, no faces visible

scenes.narration: I turned the volume up. A woman's voice. Soft. Slow. The same lullaby my mother used to sing to me. Word for word.

shots.prompt: close up of an adult hand holding a white baby monitor receiver with a volume dial, green glowing sound lights, dark bedroom, no face
empty dark nursery at night, wooden crib, mobile hanging still, faint window light

scenes.narration: My mother died eight years ago.

shots.prompt: empty wooden rocking chair in a dark corner of an old bedroom, knitted shawl draped over it, single candle, dust in the air, no people

scenes.narration: I opened the camera app. The nursery was dark. The crib was empty. But the blanket inside was moving. Like someone was tucking it in.

shots.prompt: grainy black and white night vision security camera view of an empty crib in a nursery, top down angle
night vision camera view of a baby blanket in a crib folding by itself, eerie, grainy black and white

scenes.narration: Then the singing stopped. And a voice whispered, right into the monitor: I know she's not in here. Where did you put her?

shots.prompt: extreme close up of a baby monitor speaker grille glowing in darkness, cold light, horror

scenes.narration: Next to me, my daughter opened her eyes. She wasn't scared. She smiled, and said: Grandma wants me back in my room. She says you promised.

shots.prompt: extreme close up of a rumpled white blanket on a bed in a dark room, tiny fingers curled over its edge, cold moonlight, no person visible

scenes.narration: And the bedroom door started to open.

shots.prompt: bedroom door slowly opening into a pitch black hallway, thin gap, darkness behind, horror film still

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do you check the nursery, or lock the door?

overlays.text: Check the nursery or lock the door?
